title: Census deterministic 3: cheaper reading
goal: What a census still hands a model is judged at the lowest cost that keeps its sample agreement: factdiff review items (a fact with its old and new passage) are judged in batches by a no-tool structured-output call that settles supported facts without an agent; the remaining phase-2 groups run as capped headless sessions on a smaller model whose JSON result census.py apply takes; the phase-4 sample hands its checker passages, not pages, with word-for-word rows agreed by tool; and one domain's census, run end to end on the new route, is measured against the sprint-1 baseline in model-read rows, tokens, USD and wall time.
